stem:
Alia writes questions after a rain shower. One is "Why does all energy do things?" Another is "Does sugar dissolve faster in warm water or in cold water?"

Which one has been made scientific by turning curiosity into a focused, testable question?

options.text: "Why does all energy do things?" because it is a big curiosity question.
"Does sugar dissolve faster in warm water or in cold water?" because it is focused and can be checked.
The sugar question is not scientific because it uses kitchen materials.
Neither, because science questions must already name the answer.

teacher.key_rationale: A scientific question is focused and can be checked. The sugar question can. The energy question is too broad.
